class Stack
  def initialize
    @items = []
  end

  def push(item)
    @items << item
  end

  def pop
    raise StackUnderflowError, "Cannot pop from an empty stack" if empty?
    @items.pop
  end

  def peek
    raise StackUnderflowError, "Cannot peek at an empty stack" if empty?
    @items.last
  end

  def empty?
    @items.empty?
  end

  class StackUnderflowError < StandardError; end
end
